set.body:
## Scope
Implement bounded activity queries, filter-bound opaque cursors, rendering, and CLI activity commands. Support finite history followed by a live JSONL stream without sharing reader state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Each reader receives an explicit opaque cursor bound to its query filters; advancing one reader cannot consume events for another reader.
- Queries are bounded by documented page/event/byte limits and return a clear expired-cursor/retention result.
- `rslurm activity --since`, `--after`, `--json`, and `--follow` have documented, stable output semantics; history-to-follow does not omit or duplicate the boundary event.
- A read of the local journal, including an expired cursor response, never opens SSH or invokes a remote operation.
- Tests cover two concurrent readers with disjoint cursor advancement, filter mismatch, retention expiry, bounded pagination, process restart, and JSONL follow ordering.
set.title: A1.2: add independent activity cursors and terminal JSONL follow
